---
name: Bug report
about: Report a reproducible failure using synthetic data
---

## Expected and actual behavior

## Minimal synthetic example

Include a sanitized configuration and a small synthetic corpus. Do not include real customer records,
API keys, private endpoints, credentials, tokens or production query text.

## Environment

Package/Python versions, selected providers and whether the failure occurs in the local example.

## Validation

Command, exception type, and what you have already checked. Redact sensitive request/evidence content.
